settingsCopy.scope: Actual server-rendered Settings section before and after a fresh local build. Existing processor tab/browser storage and live permissions are unchanged; this is a truthful description repair, not new browser/device qualification.

old.kind: Actual CLI pre-browser build-pin failure; cleanup probe only, no product qualification

new.kind: Actual CLI pre-browser build-pin failure; cleanup probe only, no product qualification

qaTemporaryFolders.scope: Actual CLI pre-browser build-pin rejection. OLD creates one unused temp folder per tool; NEW creates none. Explicit output semantics and wx exclusive write are retained. Defaults are unique small repo receipts. The expected bad-proof execution stays failed; only cleanup/default receipt assertions pass.

recovery: The manifest Git blob lists original root names, SHA-256 and Git blobs. git show refs/codex/evidence/2026-10-10-macos-scratch/retained-tree:<root-name>/<relative-file> recovers exact retained bytes. All non-dependency regular files and literal symlinks are retained; installed node_modules directories were discarded. The earlier heart-rate, CANopen and MCP3008 draft sources remain in docs/platform/recovered-drafts/2026-10-09/.
preservedInvalidProbe: One observer accessed an undefined JSON field as mandatory and raised KeyError after the actual subprocess exited. Its original report/log and observer diagnostic are retained and excluded from qualification; the observer was corrected before OLD/NEW comparisons.

independentReview.scope: Three literal changed source files and focused OLD/NEW/explicit/default-output evidence. No edits or launches by reviewer; historical cleanup is supported separately by the saved hash verification/open-path/process checks.

requiredGatePolicy: All five exact frozen candidate gates must pass before local commit. Named local Git evidence ref stores actual result and raw logs.
